title: Conservative neural posterior estimation via distributionally robust training
abstract: arXiv:2605.28516v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Simulation-based inference with neural posterior estimation (NPE) often yields overconfident and unreliable posteriors under limited simulation budgets. To address this, we propose DRO-NPE, a distributionally robust approach that replaces the standard NPE objective with a worst-case loss over a Wasserstein ambiguity set. We introduce KL-based metrics for miscoverage and miscalibration, and use these to show that the DRO-NPE objective controls overfitting and reduces posterior overconfidence. Our method is tractable, parallelisable, and readily integrates with standard normalising flows. Across benchmark SBI tasks, DRO-NPE consistently improves coverage and calibration, while narrowing the gap between empirical and population NPE loss, leading to more reliable inference in low-simulation regimes.

translated_title: 基于分布鲁棒训练的保守神经后验估计
translated_abstract: 基于模拟的推断中，神经后验估计（NPE）在有限的模拟预算下往往产生过度自信且不可靠的后验分布。为解决这一问题，我们提出了DRO-NPE，这是一种分布鲁棒的方法，用Wasserstein模糊集上的最坏情况损失替代标准NPE目标。我们引入了基于KL散度的覆盖不足和校准偏差度量，并利用这些度量证明DRO-NPE目标能够控制过拟合并降低后验的过度自信。我们的方法易于处理、可并行化，并且能够与标准归一化流轻松集成。在基准SBI任务上，DRO-NPE持续改善覆盖率和校准效果，同时缩小经验NPE损失与总体NPE损失之间的差距，从而在低模拟条件下实现更可靠的推断。
tldr: 提出DRO-NPE方法，通过Wasserstein模糊集上的分布鲁棒训练解决神经后验估计在有限模拟预算下过度自信的问题，显著提升了基于模拟推断的覆盖率和校准可靠性。
en_tdlr: DRO-NPE tackles overconfident posteriors in neural posterior estimation under limited simulation budgets by replacing the standard NPE objective with a worst-case loss over a Wasserstein ambiguity set, consistently improving coverage and calibration in simulation-based inference.
